name: print-social-find-your-style-post-greyscale-portrait-with-violet-slash
title: 'Find Your Style & Your Self.' post with a greyscale portrait and translucent violet diagonal slash
whatItIs: A square dark post with a close greyscale portrait of a young man, a bold white and violet headline, translucent violet diagonal bands slicing across, halftone dot grids, diagonal hatch marks and a thin rule with URL.
whatItMeans: Bold and urban; the violet slash adds energy to a moody portrait.
techniques: Slice a translucent colour band diagonally over a greyscale portrait.
Colour the second half of the headline.
Add dot grids and hatch marks as tech texture.

vocabulary.definition: A slanted stripe crossing the composition.
